name: Hy-MT2 (1.8B, 7B, 30B-A3B)
purpose: 'Fast-thinking' multilingual translation models for complex real-world scenarios: 33 languages, instruction-following translation (terminology, style), 1.8B model compressible to 440 MB with 1.25-bit quantization for on-device use (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: HF API cardData.license apache-2.0 for Hy-MT2-1.8B; licence file not opened (Hunyuan releases have used custom licences before, so verify).

architecture.kind: 1.8B dense (HunYuanDenseV1ForCausalLM), 7B dense, and 30B-A3B MoE decoder LLMs
architecture.why_this_design: Card: 'fast-thinking' translation models; AngelSlim 1.25-bit quantization for the 1.8B model gives 440 MB and 1.5x faster inference.

variants.notes: llama.cpp builds named on the card; sizes not checked

pc-24gb.notes: MoE with 3B active streams well from RAM

engine_support.notes: Official GGUF repos linked from the card.

benchmarks.name: Hy-MT2 report: general, business, domain and instruction-following translation
benchmarks.harness: IFMTBench plus standard sets; chart images only in the card text I read

strengths: 33 languages incl. German; official GGUF; terminology and style prompts documented
weaknesses: card gives results only as images; no numbers extracted
soft.maturity: Third generation of Hunyuan-MT; also a WMT26 partner (card).

tona_fit.reason: Dedicated translation model family with GGUF at every size and 33 languages: a candidate for a local translation worker next to translategemma-12b. Needs a German<->English A/B against translategemma and a read of the licence.

sources.note: report named by the card; not opened
